column1: #   On 2026-08-28, Ashlar.Commercial.Tests.Fleet.Host was found to be in no solution,
#   named by no gate script, and absent from Ashlar.sln. Its four tests had been failing
#   for at least ten days across twenty consecutive runs of a manual-first weekly gate,
#   and no pull request had ever run them. Membership in a solution looked like coverage
#   TestOwnershipConventionTests asserts that every csproj containing Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk
#   has exactly one row here. That test lives in the Ashlar.Tests.Infrastructure.Tests.
#   Certification namespace, which is what cert-gate selects — the ONE required status check
#   on master. So a new test project that is not registered here cannot merge.
#   runner   the gate, script or workflow that executes it, or UNOWNED
#   expires  YYYY-MM-DD for UNOWNED rows (the date the debt must be resolved); "-" otherwise
#   note     why, in a few words
#   UNOWNED means: no pull-request check runs this project's tests. It is a dated debt,
#   not a permanent state. The list may shrink; adding to it needs a reason.
# The runner column is documentation until a lane-deriving suite gate exists; the assertion
# that bites today is completeness. Do not treat a runner name here as proof a gate runs it.
